portfolio: single BTC sleeve, gross exposure 1.0 when active and 0 when NO_TRADE; closed-trade returns compound sequentially
daily_return: realized equity change by UTC exit day; zero-return days included
bootstrap: 200 trials, 14-day circular blocks over daily realized returns; report fraction with compounded return >0
costs: round-trip bps deducted once per closed trade
funding: sum only funding timestamps strictly inside entry<timestamp<exit; benefit x0.8 and cost x1.2 under stress/severe
